thread:
maya.marketing: Heads-up: Aurora Data agreed to a short written case blurb + a 15s demo clip. They asked about an embargo window before we publish. Who needs to sign off?

ryan.cs: Nice! For the blurb we need a one-line quote about throughput improvements and a confirmation of the test conditions (baseline infra, dataset, run length). Can the customer provide the exact numbers?

alex.pm: We want an actionable CTA that routes inbound leads to the webinar signup first, then to AE if they click "Talk to Sales". @sales-bot can you confirm routing?

sales-bot: Routing confirmed: webinar-registration -> nurture sequence -> sales-qualified leads assigned to Regional AE queue. Tagging: product-demo@redwood.io for immediate requests.

nina.legal: For embargo: standard is 48 hours. Also need explicit written permission for logo use and the quote. Suggested customer wording: "We confirm these performance figures and grant Redwood permission to use Aurora Data's name and logo in web and social marketing. This is not for press release distribution without additional approval."

maya.marketing: I'll ask Aurora for that exact line and the SVG/PNG logo. Also requesting a 15s demo clip; will they record or can we screen-record during the call?

ryan.cs: If they prefer, we can screen-record a short demo while they're sharing. Audio optional. We should capture the latency graph and the throughput numbers in the clip.

dia.design: If we get the clip, I can make a 9:16 vertical cut for socials plus a 4:5 carousel image. Need high-res logo and any brand guidelines.

alex.pm: Draft quote suggestion (to speed approvals):

alex.pm: ```
"Aurora's batch throughput increased 2.5x on average after switching to Redwood, cutting tail latency by half while maintaining output quality."
```

nina.legal: That's OK as long as Aurora confirms the numbers. Add "customer-reported" if they decline to provide raw data. Also ask them to specify allowed channels (web, social, email).

maya.marketing: Sending request to Aurora now. Will include: quote text, logo request, permission line, embargo length (48h), and ask whether they want a pre-publish review.

(20m later)
maya.marketing: Aurora replied: "We confirm the throughput and tail latency improvements for our production workload over a 2-week run. You may use our name and logo on web and social. We would like a 24-hour pre-publish review window if possible." Attached: aurora-data-lockup.svg

nina.legal: 24 hours is fine. Their reply text is acceptable. Please paste the email content into the ticket and upload the SVG to the asset PR.

dia.design: Got the SVG. I'll start the social cuts and the hero image. Need the exact quote placement and whether they want attribution to a person (CTO or company).

alex.pm: Ask them if they'd like the quote attributed to "Lena Park, CTO" or just Aurora Data. If they want an individual, get permission for full name and title.

maya.marketing: Pinging Aurora for attribution. Also scheduling a 30m internal review tomorrow to approve the landing copy and social assets. Can everyone join?

ryan.cs: I can do tomorrow 11am PT.

dia.design: 11am PT works.

nina.legal: I can make 11:30am PT by exception, but will review PR earlier if you post it.

maya.marketing: Cool 9I'll post a draft PR by EOB today. Please leave approvals in the PR (approve/request changes).

alex.pm: One more: add a short line in the landing about where to route product inquiries: "Interested in a pilot? Click Talk to Sales -> select 'Aurora pilot' in form." Makes routing cleaner.

sales-bot: Noted. We'll add a hidden UTM to funnel Aurora-related leads to the AE queue.

maya.marketing: Thanks all. Will update thread once we have final attribution and the embargo window countdown. :rocket:
